briefs.brief: Add a compact JSON export of the rung table so the dashboard can read it without parsing logs. Keep the existing text export unchanged.

goals.text: The export writes one JSON object per rung with its status and reason.
The existing text export keeps its current format.

objections: The request asks for the dashboard to read the export, but the brief never says where the file is written, so the dashboard cannot find it.
The brief keeps the text export unchanged, but the request says to replace the log parsing, which the text export feeds.
